blocks.text: The conference room is booked through next week, which I mention because you generally take it on Tuesday afternoon and it will not be free. I have put you in the front office instead from two o'clock onward, and I can move that to another afternoon if Tuesday is the only day the room would have done.

Separately, the parking validations have run out again and the new book does not arrive until the end of the month, so I would ask everyone to hold on to what they have for visitors rather than for themselves. Let me know by Thursday whether Tuesday afternoon works, and I will lock the room bookings for the week.
